The necklace features alternating amber-colored spherical beads and white/cream irregular shell or stone pieces, connected by silver wire loops. A large, flat, circular pendant with a blue-green marbled pattern hangs on the right side. The chain forms a loose loop in the foreground and extends towards the background.
